title: DriverAnonymized v1 payload
description: Published by driver when staff complete a driver's deletion request and the driver is anonymized (REQ-PRV-04, REQ-PRV-07, issue #144). Aggregate Driver. Identity writes it to the erasure journal (ADR 0013); each module removes the driver's personal data it owns: notification the push devices and notification texts, operations the driver's chat messages and rating comments, backoffice the driver's support cases. Earnings, the ledger, trips and the vehicle stay (AC-24). Consumers are idempotent.
